maya-sales: Heads up team — WellBridge (EU payer) needs a single POC assurance bundle by May 10. They asked for: SOC 2 Type II excerpts, ISO 27001 cert, network/topology diagram focused on EU region, signed pen-test attestation (they explicitly requested signed letter), and clarification on whether Dedicated vs Private changes cost or rollout timeline. Can someone own and confirm ETA? @lucy-security? :slightly_smiling_face:

peter-ae: Quick clarifying qs: Do they want the full SOC2 report or a control-excerpt + system description? Also, do we need to redact vendor contact details? I think they only want EU-scope docs but will confirm with PO.

lucy-security: I can own the artifact pull. Plan: SOC2 Type II excerpt (control matrix + system description redacted for vendor contacts), ISO cert scan copy, and an updated EU network diagram. For the signed pen-test attestation we use standard wording ("no critical findings as of [scan date]") — legal needs to sign. I can have draft ready in 48h after scope confirmed.

upload-bot: Created proofpack workspace: s3://proofpacks/wellbridge/1736409999/
Presign (48h):
curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood/proofpacks/1736409999?sig=xyz789" -F file=@evidence.zip
(Do not paste secrets in channel) :lock:

tran-infra: For scans we can provision 4 static IPs (external) within 24h once owner assigned. Dedicated during POC adds approx +$7k/mo to the evaluation credits. Private (VPC/on-prem) requires setup ~10 business days and a ~$15k one-time onboarding fee. If they need KMS/HSM separation details, we can include a high-level summary of key management posture for Private.

ana-legal: (ana-legal) We can sign a pen-test attestation on company letterhead. Need recipient name, exact requested wording, and confirmation that NDA allows sending signed artifacts. Typical turnaround: draft 1 business day, signature same day once approved by GC. If they want a third-party pen-test report we need to coordinate with the vendor team — that can take longer.

maya-sales: Target: final bundle delivered to customer by May 6 so they have a few days to review before May 10 kickoff. Peter please confirm Type II vs Type I and redaction preference with PO today. Lucy please queue the draft attestation for legal after Peter confirms. Tran please reserve IPs and note them in the proofpack manifest.

peter-ae: Pinged PO. They said Type II excerpts only and redaction of internal contacts is fine. Also asked for KMS note if Private used. Will confirm recipient name for signed letter by EOD. :thumbsup:

lucy-security: Acknowledged. I'll start pulling artifacts and will upload initial zip to the s3 path once ready. Draft pen-test attestation will be posted here for legal review tomorrow morning.

ana-legal: Ack. Once draft posted, include recipient email and I'll triage for signature. If they request expedited turn we'll prioritize.

maya-sales: Thanks all — flag any blockers here. :pray:
